extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF results, figures, and Information S1 methods; direct classes are limited to assays actually present in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BR2 internalization in HeLa cells depends on energy and is inhibited by cholesterol depletion, amiloride, gangliosides/sialic acid, and ganglioside biosynthesis inhibition, supporting lipid raft-mediated macropinocytosis with ganglioside involvement.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BR2 peptide uptake in HeLa cancer cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is for cell penetration/cargo delivery, not a direct antimicrobial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BR2-scFv delivery into HCT116 cells reduces Ras-GTP activity and increases apoptosis markers relative to controls, consistent with anti-Ras scFv cargo action after BR2-mediated delivery.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BR2-anti-Ras scFv fusion protein in HCT116 K-ras mutated cells

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=19:BR2-anti-Ras scFv Fusion Protein Promotes Apoptosis; xml:fig=5:Figure 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: The apoptosis/Ras result belongs to the BR2-scFv construct; it should not be generalized to unconjugated BR2 antimicrobial activity.
